Portable source distribution of **CMock** ([ThrowTheSwitch/CMock](https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/CMock)), a mock and stub generator for C that works together with the Unity unit test framework. This repository is consumed by the Embedbits Platform Artifact Handler to locate, download, verify, and configure CMock in downstream embedded projects.

CMock has two parts, both shipped in this package:

- a **Ruby generator** (`lib/cmock.rb`) that parses C headers and generates `Mock<name>.c/.h` files at build time — requires the **Ruby** artifact,
- a small **C runtime** (`src/cmock.c`) compiled into the test binary — requires the **Unity** artifact headers.

This repository is split into three branches/refs by role — the `main` (`master`) branch you are reading now holds only this documentation; the handler scripts live on the `Core` branch, and versioned source packages are published as GitHub Releases anchored to the `Bin` branch.

---

## Repository contents

```
main / master
└── README.md                     ← This document — no other content

Core
├── ArtifactConfig.cmake          ← Artifact metadata (name, version constraints, asset naming)
└── CMakeCMockDefaults.cmake      ← CMock integration logic (mock generation, runtime library)

Bin  (anchor branch — no tracked binary files)
└── (empty commits only; each release tag points here)
```

---

## Role in the platform

```
GitHub (ThrowTheSwitch)                   GitHub (Embedbits)
──────────────────────────────────────    ──────────────────────────────────────────
ThrowTheSwitch/CMock                      Artifact-cmock
  tag "v2.6.0" (source)               ──►    main / master →  README only (this document)
                                              Core          →  ArtifactConfig.cmake, CMakeCMockDefaults.cmake
                                              Bin           →  Anchor branch (empty commits)
                                              Releases      →  cmock-<version>.zip + .hash
                                                                tagged Bin/<version>
```

`CMock_Importer.sh` clones the upstream repository at each release tag (`vX.Y.Z`), verifies the checked-out tag, strips `.git` metadata, adds a plain-text `VERSION` file, and zips the source tree. CMock is platform independent (Ruby + C source), so releases carry **no platform suffix** — they are tagged plainly `Bin/<version>` (the `v` prefix is dropped).

Upstream's `vendor/unity` and `vendor/c_exception` git submodules are **not** included — they only serve CMock's own self-tests. Unity is pinned independently via the Unity artifact.

---

## Branch structure

| Branch / Ref | Content |
|---|---|
| `main` / `master` | This README only — no functional content |
| `Core` | CMake handler scripts for consuming the artifact |
| `Bin` | Anchor branch only — no binaries are committed here |
| Release tag `Bin/<version>` | GitHub Release carrying the `.zip` source package and its `.hash` checksum file |

> **Note:** On a Git host without a Releases API (Azure DevOps), the same importer commits the `.zip` + `.hash` directly to the `Bin` branch and tags that commit `Bin/<version>`. The CMake handler resolves either form transparently.

---

## Fetching a release

```bash
# Core handler scripts
git clone --branch Core --single-branch --depth=1 <repository_url> cmock-core

# Source package + checksum for one specific version (GitHub Release asset)
gh release download Bin/2.6.0 --repo Embedbits/Artifact-cmock --pattern "cmock-2.6.0.*"
```

---

## Package layout

```
cmock-<version>.zip
└── cmock/
    ├── VERSION                   ← plain-text version, e.g. "2.6.0"
    ├── lib/                      ← Ruby generator (cmock.rb + plugins)
    ├── config/                   ← default generator configuration
    ├── src/                      ← cmock.c, cmock.h, cmock_internals.h
    ├── vendor/unity/             ← empty (submodule not fetched — use the Unity artifact)
    └── ...                       ← upstream docs, examples, tests
```

Example mock generation with the Ruby artifact:

```bash
ruby cmock/lib/cmock.rb -o<config.yml> path/to/header.h
```

---

## Versioning

Artifact versions correspond directly to **official CMock release tags** with the `v` prefix removed:

```
2.5.3, 2.6.0, 2.7.0, ...
```
